candidates.translation: Кто ты такой, что смеешь здесь так себя вести?

context_before_en: Horse General...
Why didn't the new stable keeper come and greet me?
He... is grooming the horses.
Move!
What's this? Who released the Heaven horses?
context_after_en: How dare you, demon head? The Jade Emperor appoints you to look after the horses and you release them?
If a single horse is missing... mind your head.
Who do you think you are to come and discipline me?
I was ordered by the Jade Emperor to watch over you, demon head!
Now be good and listen!
